title: DOW-UAP-D25, Mission Report, Greece, January 2024
doc_notes: This is a declassified military mission report (MISREP) from the Department of War containing a specific UAP incident report.

encounters.summary: Military aircraft observed a round diamond-shaped UAP with a non-maneuvering tail probe while in transit; it was detected only via SWIR camera for approximately two minutes.
encounters.entity_appearance: Round diamond shape with a straight, non-maneuverable tail probe.
encounters.quote: The UAP appeared diamond in shape with a non-manuevering probe at the bottom.
